why: Run L4 sub-run L4a's leftovers that no later run L4 area owns (cut-line items and small findings): for the final check F or a polish area.

items.text: C3-left-5 cases (the handover test's continuation, Stop now during a continuation, project removal dropping its continuation, a readmit case where B is not already promised), L4-creds-12 (background jobs marked 'not done for the period' after a held call, with a log line), the L4-creds-13 bench half (a Claude Code stand-in on the bench that does work and reports the limit) and L4-creds-14 (BA-7's composed restart cases and BA-3's effort-max case in task-budget-all.test.ts).
scrubEnv (packages/runtime/src/agent/sdk.ts) passes the host's CLAUDE* and CCR_* variables to the Claude Code subprocess; pass only what the run needs.
validZone still falls back to UTC for other callers; scheduled jobs read the person's zone at start (L4a made the credential paths read it at each use).
The bench recorder writes the bench token into requestfailed URLs in problems.jsonl.

Session lead decision (L4a merge, 2026-11-22): the share ask card's title stays 'Use your API key until Tue 1 Dec?' (the existing share form, as the triage said); the time of day adds nothing at a month boundary.
